name: w02_west_squall_line
title: West sectors, severe squall line, unable RVSM, formation, arrival sequences
description: West North + West South band-boxed, near capacity. A severe squall line (tops FL450-500) lies across West South with two gaps, drifting north-east. GCRR arrivals via TERTO and GMMN arrivals via MARJA (LoA FL250, 10 NM in trail). A Moroccan F-16 four-ship leaves ROLRO for the oceanic area via NIDEB.
design_notes: RYR4WJ (northbound UN858, FL380) reports unable RVSM at T+15:00; at T+21:40 it crosses RAM1201 (BEXAL-IBALU-SALCA to Marrakech, FL370) in West North: legal with RVSM, a loss of separation without (2000 ft needed). N215CJ (C550 ferry, not RVSM approved) asks FL400: approving it is an RVSM airspace violation. VIPER21 (4xF16, NIPRI-NIDEB-ROLRO at FL310, non-RVSM formation, 2000 ft from everyone) crosses SWR2NK northbound on UN858 at FL320. Three GCRR arrivals reach TERTO 50 s apart (FL350-390) and two GMMN arrivals reach MARJA 45 s apart: spacing and LoA level. The squall line funnels the West South traffic through two gaps.
